name: Plexus Canvas
description: Native Thymer infinite-canvas whiteboard (no @excalidraw). A drawing is a record. Embedded in-image region references: cite a region of an image, click the note chip to fly back and SPOTLIGHT the exact spot in place (no crop copy); anchored to the image element so it survives moves/resizes/rotation; on-image ↗ pins; web+desktop synced via blob filename.
